tools.name: get_video_info
tools.description: Read a public Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, X, Facebook, Pinterest, Threads, Vimeo or Reddit post: title, author, duration, available qualities, caption and hashtags.

tools.name: download_media
tools.description: Prepare a download of a public post: video (MP4), audio (MP3), image, thumbnail/cover, or a frame at a timestamp. Optional trim with start/end (e.g. '1:05'). Returns a download URL valid for 15 minutes. Only for content the user owns or may use.

tools.name: transcribe_video
tools.description: Transcribe a public video or Reel with Whisper (90+ languages, optional translation to English, optional section). Returns the text with timestamps. Videos up to 20 minutes per run.

tools.name: youtube_channel_id
tools.description: Find the YouTube channel ID (UC...), handle, channel URL and RSS feed from a @handle, channel link or any video link.

tools.name: social_video_specs
tools.description: 2026 upload specs (aspect ratio, resolution, max length, file size, caption and hashtag limits) for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Snapchat and Threads, each with official sources.

tools.name: creator_monetization
tools.description: Sourced 2026 data on creator monetization: platform programs and requirements, YouTube/TikTok RPM by niche or country, engagement-rate benchmarks, sponsored post rates.

tools.name: loudness_and_subtitles
tools.description: Loudness targets (LUFS, true peak) for Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Netflix, Prime Video, EBU R128, ATSC, podcasts and social video; subtitle rules (Netflix, BBC); frame rates and drop frame. Each value sourced.

tools.name: youtube_thumbnail_trends
tools.description: This week's measured thumbnail trends of the most-viewed new YouTube videos in 10 niches: share with faces, text, big text, brightness, colours, title length, plus top examples.

tools.name: estimate_youtube_earnings
tools.description: Estimate YouTube ad earnings (USD range per month and year) from monthly views and niche, or for Shorts.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_video_info · Private data: social_video_specs · Public sink: get_video_info, download_media, social_video_specs, creator_monetization, youtube_thumbnail_trends · Destructive: transcribe_video, loudness_and_subtitles.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_video_info · Private data: social_video_specs · Public sink: get_video_info, download_media, social_video_specs, creator_monetization, youtube_thumbnail_trends · Destructive: transcribe_video, loudness_and_subtitles

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
